objective: Freeze the bounded production-qualification programme, evidence/authority boundaries, requirement-to-package acceptance map and reference-profile limits before implementation of authentication, live release or durable deployment. Publish the reviewed plan and contracts on a separately declared, reviewable documentation PR.
nonGoals: No publisher signature verification, hosted release verification, credential/grant issuance, artifact publication, real installation, deployment, migration, telemetry polling or incident mutation in PQ-00
No changes under src/, tests/, .github/ or repository/org settings, no production target contact and no edits to unrelated projects
Do not rewrite historical SF-13 through SF-19 fixture outputs, claim production readiness, add mandatory reviewers or turn SF-R10 into an implicit pass
Do not bypass protected main, merge or start a release solely because the PQ-00 documentation PR is ready
decisions: Separate factory release from adopter deployment and distinguish source integration, scoped qualification, publication, installation and production activation

Use GitHub artifact attestations as first publisher adapter for public s-f only, with candidate-independent verifier and operator-controlled trust policy; private adopter support requires a separate declared capability
Use independently retrieved and evaluated provider CI/release facts and destination-specific, effect-scoped grant at the effect boundary; do not make a second human reviewer mandatory
Use SQLite WAL on local disk for serial single-host durable coordinator with target-enforced fencing or an equivalent atomic precondition; do not advertise a distributed lease
Use a disposable Linux reference service as the initial live deployment target only after explicit target/credential authorization
Preserve SF-14/15/16/SF-19 offline fixtures and their false production authorization flags; SF-17/18 deferred, SF-R10 overall unmet

obligations.description: Record PQ-00..PQ-08 objectives, serial dependencies, risk-first acceptance, status, external activation blockers, no bypass/unauthorized effects and resource policy.
Map each outstanding SF requirement to individual production claims, scope, independent evidence and fail-closed/unavailable status; distinguish portable factory from reference adapter.

Specify future schemas and immutable identities for publisher policy/evidence, independent CI observations, artifact and grant/release, durable operation/fence, target receipts and durable incidents, with owner and failure behavior; no implementation claimed.
Capture replaced verifier/policy, wrong signer or workflow, revocation/downgrade, forged CI/approval, after-effect crash, stale worker, spoofed live observations and mixed trust domains.
Confirm no runtime/CI/workflow change; preserve prior source/fixture claims as unqualified and no SF-R10 waiver or mandatory human reviewer.

structure: docs/factory/SF_PRODUCTION_QUALIFICATION_PLAN.md: authoritative PQ execution sequence, stage gates, prerequisites, resource policy and scope
docs/factory/PQ00_CONTRACTS.md: declarative future authority/evidence identity, acceptance and negative-case contracts, not runtime schemas
docs/product/REQUIREMENTS.md: requirement/claim traceability and non-passing SF-R10 status
docs/product/THREAT_MODEL.md: additional authority boundary and recovery/observation threats
docs/factory/PROJECT.md and README.md: project route and visible current stage
docs/factory/evidence/PQ-00.md: source-bound design and preservation evidence
impact: Documentation-only contract freeze; no new runtime capability and no grant of release, install or deployment authority
Independent requirements and threat statements govern later code work; original fixture contracts remain unaffected

budget.network: GitHub repository reads and branch/PR writes only; no release, destination or other-project calls
budget.execution: Use existing baseline evidence. One normal required PR-stage CI and, only after separately authorized merge, protected merge-group checks; no redundant action runs.

externalEffects: Create only one isolated branch and one PQ-00 PR in spsoftwarefc/s-f
No direct protected main write, merge, queue insertion, release, deploy, credential creation, target contact or repository setting change
No target-project modification and no reviewer requests solely for factory acceptance
